verification.method: GitHub REST API (releases/tags, git/ref/tags, git/tags, git/trees) via tools/omes-release-verify.mjs; the installer is never downloaded or executed.
verification.notes: The v0.6.0 install/bootstrap.sh still sets OMES_DEFAULT_STABLE_TAG=v0.4.0, so the command pins --ref v0.6.0 explicitly; without it the installer would install v0.4.0. OMES's own v0.6.0 README still shows the v0.4.0 command (upstream discrepancy).
